classification_definitions.integration: Core assertions materially use real project service/API/network/store/process boundary; offline fake surroundings do not establish external provider execution.
classification_definitions.unit: Asserted behavior is local validation, encoding, concurrency, selection or stub-only response; incidental real setup does not change it.
classification_definitions.mixed: Distinct local-only assertion blocks coexist with materially real boundary assertions.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Mapping or connected source is insufficient; distinct from runtime UNKNOWN.

func nativeRestoreFixture(t *testing.T) (*retainedConsumerFixture, nativeReleaseBinding, nativeReleaseBinding, *nativeRegressionWriter) {
	t.Helper()
	f := newRetainedConsumerFixture(t)
	p := nativeRegressionProfile()
	p.Env["REVISION"] = "A"
	a := f.binding(t, terrabase.Role, p, nativeRegressionAdopt(t, f, p, 1), 1)
	p = cloneNativeProfile(p)
	p.Env["REVISION"], p.Resources.CPU = "B", 2
	b := f.binding(t, terrabase.Role, p, nativeRegressionAdopt(t, f, p, 2), 2)
	p = cloneNativeProfile(p)
	p.Env["REVISION"], p.Resources.CPU = "C", 3
	nativeRegressionAdopt(t, f, p, 3)
	previous := nativeGoodRelease{Binding: a, Nodes: []string{"ctl-1"}, GoodAt: time.Now()}
	f.save(t, terrabase.Role, nativeReleaseHistory{Schema: 1, Pending: &b, Previous: &previous,
		Good: []nativeGoodRelease{{Binding: b, Nodes: []string{"ctl-1"}, GoodAt: time.Now()}, previous}})
	f.desired(t, b)
	writer := &nativeRegressionWriter{history: f.history, fixture: f}
	nativeRegressionDelivery(t, f, nativeRegressionPlanner{history: f.history, nodes: 1}, writer)
	return f, a, b, writer
}

func restoreIntent(binding nativeReleaseBinding) delivery.Intent {
	i := binding.Intent
	i.OperationID, i.Generation = entityid.New(), 3
	return i
}

restore.reason: Reads history and receipt, rejects operation collision, records invalid-target refusal, or selects/verifies retained profile and CAS-saves Recovery. No direct process launch.

restore_target.reason: Local matching and ambiguity/predessor preference over supplied structs.

delivery_status.reason: Reads operation via real NATS leader GetLastMsg and verifies receipt fingerprint.

delivery_refusal.reason: Records rejected operation with recordIntentReceipt then reads it back with getOperation; fixture authorization/fence are synthetic.

host_desired.reason: Production host desired discovery calls stream.Info and real ordered-log GetLastMsgForSubject; fixture publications are actually read, not returned as mock API records.

host_list.reason: Reads real ordered registration/retirement and session state. Fixture session/registration data is synthetic; no live host agent.

resources.reason: For committed desired targets, load persisted native history and verify binding; committed resources can differ from current profile.

planner.reason: Plan uses history profile, real ListHosts/ListDesired and history resources before local placement. Both refusal and available-capacity cases depend materially on these reads.

telemetry.reason: recordCommitted obtains real desired/history resources before updating local normalization windows and runtime-observability store. Report feed remains synthetic.

fence_fixture.reason: Real local NATS KV; load balancer, host inventory/health, lease leadership and journal are fake. The root overrides gate to a no-I/O callback.

netbird_journal_fake.reason: NetBird records are held in fenceLease.netbird memory under a mutex, not the actual broker KV. Restarted root only reconstructs an object sharing the same fake lease, not a process restart.

netbird_admission.reason: Admission early guard checks fence/address before committing fake journal. preflightAddresses overlays saved selected address from fake state; status keys route to real fence KV.

netbird_inventory.reason: Inventory case follows fake journal and fake fenceCell.ListHosts; no OCI fleet call is reached with its fixture registrations.

netbird_drain.reason: Reads fake saved journal, uses admitted fence then calls releaseFence.fence against real fence KV with fake LB.

release_fence_store.reason: Hold save uses KV.Put, root f.record reads KV.Get and final restore deletes same hold; spec removal reconcile lists keys and preserves nonrelease hold. Fake LB guards do not establish OCI quorum.

artifact_fixture.reason: Real loopback NATS server/client, object store and status KV; fenceLease journal is still in memory. Fixture ELF bytes are not executed.

netbird_preflight.reason: preflight performs real object metadata/content/retention reads and status KV load; cluster callback is synthetic and stops path before recoverySSH. Missing status asserts health refusal after actual KV read.

qualification_limits: UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION for all roots. No test, Go, build, formatter, lint, benchmark or helper execution.
No live OCI, Vault, cloud, signing, crypto, TerraBase, NetBird daemon, SSH, mesh, actual task process or quorum exercise performed; only source read.
Single-broker FileStorage/ordered-log source paths do not qualify restart, crash durability, real multi-controller elections or production trust.
NetBird journal is in-memory fenceLease; reconstructed object shares it. LB/inventory/quorum hooks are fake; fence KV and preflight status/object-store paths are real boundaries only in source.
All original assertions, negative/fencing/security/retention obligations remain retained; no deletion/retirement/count/ledger/runtime qualification promotion.

The retained-consumer fixture reaches real natscell server.NewServer/Start and JetStream APIs, but its embedded controller/system clients use nats.InProcessServer. Integration categories assert real embedded protocol/store behavior, not external TCP/TLS, host-client transport, bridge use, multi-node cluster or live network qualification.
